AMENDED

  AGENDA
  CITY OF HAWAIIAN GARDENS
  REGULAR MEETING
  PUBLIC SAFETY COMMISSION
  JANUARY 15, 2020

NOTICE IS HEREBY GIVEN, that a Regular Meeting of the Hawaiian Gardens Public
Safety Commission is hereby called to be held on Wednesday, January 15, 2020,
beginning at 6:00pm, at the Public Safety Center, 11940 Carson Street, 2nd Floor,
Hawaiian Gardens, California 90716.

PLEASE TURN OFF OR SILENCE ALL CELL PHONES DURING THE MEETING.

Please note: The City of Hawaiian Gardens complies with the provisions of the
Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). Anyone needing special assistance is asked to
please contact the Public Safety Center at (562) 496-1026, at least one (1) business
day prior to the meeting so that we may accommodate you.

PLEDGE OF ALLEGIANCE

ROLL CALL  CHAIRMEMBER  BARBARA LAUGHLIN
  VICE CHAIRMEMBER  LIZET MENDOZA
  COMMISSIONER  PEDRO AMARO
  COMMISSIONER  MARIO RICO
  COMMISSIONER  BERTHA MERAZ

NONE

PUBLiC COMMENTS - ITEMS ON AND OFF THE AGENDA
This is the time reserved for members of the audience wishing to speak on items on
and off the Agenda and within the legislative body's jurisdiction. This period will be
limited to three (3) minutes per speaker.

NONE
